This error usually happens due to a NumPy–Pandas version mismatch (binary incompatibility).
Fix (recommended): reinstall both with compatible versions**
!pip install --upgrade --force-reinstall numpy pandas
`Then restart the runtime/kernel(very important). 
Alternative (stable combo):
!pip install numpy==1.26.4 pandas==2.2.2
``Restart again after installing.
This should resolve the issue.
